title: Base-changed coefficient complex system and colimit comparisons
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $I$ a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Over}(S)$ a diagram with affine transitions and qcqs structure morphisms. Let $c$ have limiting underlying scheme cone and qcqs structure morphism. Let $F_i,\phi$ be abelian etale coefficients with the identity and composition HEq laws in the Lean signature, and $H:I\to\mathrm{Sh}(c.pt)$ with isomorphisms $eH_i:H_i\simeq f_i^{-1}F_i$ and canonical transition equation. Fix $p\in\mathbb N$ and an affine etale $U\to S$. The groups $R(g_i,F_i,U,p)$ and $R(g,\operatorname{colim}H,U,p)$ of [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology], with the canonical restricted pullback/coefficient maps from $\phi_i=(eH_i)^{-1}\operatorname{colimit}.\iota_i$, admit the following complex-system realization: an $I^{op}$ diagram $D'$ of qcqs schemes with affine maps and a limiting cone $c'$; complexes $K_i$ with coherent inverse-image transitions and zero terms below degree zero; a diagram $G$ of their pullbacks to the limit with isomorphisms $eG_i$ and the canonical transition equation; and a coefficient cocone $L$ with $\mathrm{IsColimit}(L)$ and zero vertex terms in negative degrees.  Instead of constructing a cohomology diagram, provide isomorphisms r_i from the restricted-cohomology groups R_i to H^p(D'i,QK_i), and r_L from R_limit to H^p(c'.pt,QL.pt). For each cone projection, r_i followed by rawAffineComplexPullback and the coefficient map (eG_i)^(-1) followed by L.iota_i equals the canonical restricted-cohomology map followed by r_L. The full hypotheses and morphism equality are given verbatim in lean.statement. No cohomology diagram T or cocone B is supplied.

proof.text: Construct U ×_S D(i), its pullback transitions and cone U ×_S c.pt using the pullback universal property. The universal property gives identity, composition and the limit assertion. Affine, quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphisms remain so under base change; the affine target U makes stage schemes compact and quasi-separated.

Restrict F_i and phi along the second projections, using rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient. The identity and associativity of upperStarComp transport the sheaf transition laws. Apply singleFunctor in degree zero. Restrict and reindex H and use eH to obtain G, eG and hG. Single complexes vanish in negative degrees.

Restriction is left adjoint and preserves the coefficient colimit. singleFunctor preserves colimits degreewise, so the image cocone L is colimiting. Its vertex is the degree-zero single complex of the restricted coefficient colimit, so it also vanishes in negative degrees, giving hbelowL. The stage cohomology comparisons r are the single-complex identifications; the preserved coefficient colimit gives rL. On each cone triangle, the inverse-image comparisons in eG are exactly rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient. Naturality of the single comparison identifies the Q-image coefficient map in the displayed morphism equation; compose with rawAffineComplexPullback.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_restricted_affine_coefficient_system {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S)
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, HEq (φ (𝟙 i))
      ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj (op i)).left).hom.app (F i)))
    (hφcomp : ∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), HEq (φ (f ≫ g))
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g.op).left
          (D.map f.op).left).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((D.map g.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ φ g))
    (H : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅
      (((c.π.app (op i)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i))
    (hH : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c.π.app (op j)).left (D.map f.op).left
          (c.π.app (op i)).left
          (congrArg (fun t => t.left) (c.w f.op)).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((c.π.app (op j)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    [HasColimit H] (p : ℕ)
    (U : S.Etale) [IsAffine U.left] :
    ∃
    (D' : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{v})
    (c' : Cone D')
    (hc : IsLimit c')
    (compact : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D'.obj i))
    (quasiSeparated : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D'.obj i))
    (affine : ∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D'.map f))
    (K : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CochainComplex (Sheaf (D'.obj i).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ)
    (ψ : ∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : j ⟶ i),
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.map f)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (K i) ⟶ K j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, ψ (𝟙 i) =
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
        (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) (D'.map_id i)))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.obj i))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : Iᵒᵖ) (f : j ⟶ i) (g : k ⟶ j),
      ψ (g ≫ f) =
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.map g) (D'.map f)
            (D'.map (g ≫ f)) (D'.map_comp g f))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.map g)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (ψ f) ≫ ψ g)
    (hbelow : ∀ (i : Iᵒᵖ) (n : ℤ), n < 0 → IsZero ((K i).X n))
    (G : (Iᵒᵖ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (Sheaf c'.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ)
    (eG : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, G.obj (op i) ≅
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c'.π.app i)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (K i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : j ⟶ i), G.map f.op =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c'.π.app j) (D'.map f)
            (c'.π.app i) (c'.w f).symm) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (K i) ≫
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c'.π.app j)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (ψ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G)
    (hL : IsColimit L)
    (hbelowL : ∀ n : ℤ, n < 0 → IsZero (L.pt.X n))
    (r : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ,
      rawAffineRestrictedCohomology (D.obj (op i.unop)).hom p (F i.unop) U ≅
        (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D'.obj i) (p : ℤ)).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (K i)))
    (rL : rawAffineRestrictedCohomology c.pt.hom p (colimit H) U ≅
      (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} c'.pt (p : ℤ)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L.pt)),
    ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ,
      (r i).hom ≫ rawAffineComplexPullback (p : ℤ) (c'.π.app i) (K i) ≫
        (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} c'.pt (p : ℤ)).map
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app (op i))) =
      rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i.unop)).left
        (D.obj (op i.unop)).hom c.pt.hom (Over.w (c.π.app (op i.unop))) p
        (F i.unop) (colimit H) ((eH i.unop).inv ≫ colimit.ι H i.unop) U ≫ rL.hom
